contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CON[S]T[--] ; R/ [VICTORIA LAETAE PRINC] PERP

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Two Victories issue of 318-320, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust, youthful, helmeted and probably cuirassed, left. Obverse inscription: IMP CON[S]T[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding shield over altar. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIA LAETAE PRINC] PERP. Diameter: 17.7mm, Weight: 2.32gms, die axis: 12
